module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder -500, so one of the first) that manages camera paths (camPath) during a project. It loads a <name>/<name>.camPath.json file relative to the project via core_paths.loadPath, or stores a path provided in memory, then plays it with core_paths.playPath. It tracks the active path, the number of path completions and the loop mode.
notes: Paths are identified by an integer id local to the module (getFreeId) and indexed by name in pathIds.
Bug (copy-paste): getCmd returns a command that calls the 'button' module (buttonClicked); unusable for the camera.
afterTrigger contains an empty scheduleAction block.
isPathComplete raises an error if activePathId == id but completions is nil (should not happen after startPath).
getPathDuration reads the time of the last marker; error if the path has no marker.

init.desc: Creates the variableStorage and calls clear().

clear.desc: Resets the active path, the completions and the stored path tables.

findPath.desc: Returns the id of the path with this name, loading it if needed from <name>/<name>.camPath.json (resolved by mgr:getRelativeAbsolutePath). Logs an error if the file is not found.

addCustomPath.desc: Registers an already built path under a name. Without force, returns the existing id if the name is already known.

getPathDuration.desc: Path duration = time of the last marker, 0 if the path is unknown.

isPathComplete.desc: True if this path is the active path and has been completed at least once.

startPath.desc: Switches to the game camera if the free camera is active, then plays the path with core_paths.playPath (useDtReal = true) and stores the id, the loop and completions = 0. Does nothing if the id is unknown.

finishedPath.desc: Callback called by core_paths at the end of a path: without loop, stops the camera; in all cases increments completions.

endActivePath.desc: Stops the active path (if id is nil or equal to the active one) and clears the state.

restartActivePath.desc: Restarts the active path with the same loop setting (if id is nil or equal to the active one).

getCmd.desc: Builds a Lua command for the 'button' module (see notes: probable copy-paste).

afterTrigger.desc: Called after the graph tick: finalizes the variables.

executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops: stops the path camera if active then calls clear().
